Name: Every measure has a description
Description: Project standard: every measure explains what it means in business words.

Name: Every measure sits in a numbered display folder
Description: Measures are grouped in numbered display folders (01 Revenue, 02 Cost, ...).

Name: Divide measures with DIVIDE, not /
Description: A / between two measures returns an error or infinity when the denominator is 0 or blank. Dividing by a constant (1e7) is fine.

Name: Hide foreign keys
Description: Fact-side key columns are for relationships, not for report users.

Name: Hide numeric fact columns (use measures)
Description: Report users get explicit measures, never implicit sums of fact columns.
Expression: Table.Name.StartsWith("Fact") and (DataType = "Double" or DataType = "Int64" or DataType = "Decimal") and not IsHidden

Name: Relationships filter in one direction
Description: Bi-directional filters create ambiguity and slow the model. Star schema, one-to-many, single direction.

Name: Dim Date is marked as the date table
Description: Time intelligence needs a marked date table with a unique, contiguous Date key.
Expression: Name = "Dim Date" and (DataCategory <> "Time" or not Columns.Any(IsKey))

Name: Implicit measures are switched off
Description: discourageImplicitMeasures stops users summing raw columns (and is required by the calculation group).
